scope: offline synthetic interval and in-memory task ledger model only
limitations: Unknown real error/ppm bounds refuse production authority; factory numbers are synthetic assumptions.
All-guest-clock VM freeze can be observationally indistinguishable; it is not detected by the model.
Uncharacterized VM profiles refuse construction; fixture-profile success cannot establish real VM behavior.
JSON task restore is in-memory only, not PostgreSQL/checkpoint/crash recovery.
Prior 8 latency tests were not rerun or counted here.
